description: Dept. of Local Government- North Central Province Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 Notice of Roads and Lanes Owned by Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the identification, mapping, registration, and legal recognition of roads and lanes maintained by Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies). It involves establishing boundaries, creating maps with geographical coordinates, maintaining registers of roads, and gazetting notifications about road ownership - all falling under land administration and property matters.
